_readme: Sample answers for Services Runtime cmdlets run outside a recovery plan. Load the file with Import-VCFIRAnswerFile.

Get-ServicesRuntimeComponentBackups uses group 1 and Y to build the restore JSON. If you choose custom group 0 when offered, supply one backup point ID per component in the order prompted before the final Y/N.

Start-ServicesRuntimeComponentBackup uses the VCF instance ID, component IDs or ALL, then Y/N. The sample selects all components in instance 1 and declines submission. When passing -ComponentIds, provide only the final Y/N answer.
Remove-VcfmsComponent takes one Y/N confirmation. The sample declines deletion. Set it to Y only after reviewing the selected component IDs.
